company_description: Mid-sized fintech platform building personalization and compliance-sensitive customer support workflows. Heavy on PII and transaction history, requires strict controls and auditability.
crm_notes:
Status: Closed-lost (security)
- Opportunity progressed quickly after demo (Dec 2025) — CTO enthusiastic about latency and routing features.
- Security review started Jan 2026. They asked for SOC2/ISO evidence and completed our security questionnaire.
- Legal asked for attestations (SOC2 report or ISO certificate) + controls mapping to our KMS/HSM recommendations.
- On 2026-02-18 security said: 'We cannot accept self-attestation; need audited reports. If vendor refuses to provide, corp legal will not sign.'
- Customer unwilling to share internal compliance audit extracts and expected vendor to provide public SOC2/ISO docs. Our hosted roadmap for SOC2 in H2 2026 was unacceptable.
- CompetitorX offered an on-prem packaged deployment + signed SOC2 evidence; Onyx moved budget to partner pilot. Quote lost Feb 24.
- Notes from last call: "We're not able to sign without proof — moving forward with vendor who can provide audit paperwork or full on-prem install." — Onyx Head of Security
- AE attempted escalation to solutions + legal 2026-02-20; no internal champion to push tradeoffs.
- Follow-up: recommend wait for SOC2 completion, supply gap remediation plan; marketing to re-open in 6-9 months.
timeline: 2025-12-10: Intro demo (AE Maya + SE Diego) — positive reception
2026-01-06: POC kickoff, limited trial on dedicated nodes requested
2026-02-18: Security declined self-attestation; asked for audited reports
2026-02-24: Onyx verbally accepted CompetitorX pilot; procurement freeze for Redwood
requirements_summary: Workload: real-time support chat + reranking over transaction histories. Latency targets: p95 < 120ms for chat, throughput 200 qps. Data residency in US, strict retention rules. Must support SSO (SAML), audit logs, KMS-managed keys, and external SOC2/ISO evidence. Preferred on-prem or VPC private deployment for initial rollout.
decision_reason: Closed-lost: primary blocker was security review. Onyx required audited SOC2/ISO evidence and explicit controls mapping. Redwood's roadmap did not satisfy their timeline and Onyx declined to accept self-attestation or partial evidence. CompetitorX provided on-prem package + SOC2 report and won pilot. Also internal budget reallocation to CompetitorX caused procurement freeze for Redwood.
next_steps_detail: Document gaps and remediation plan (owner: Diego). Create playbook for SOC2 evidence requests and a short evidence packet (public attestations) to speed future reviews. Re-engage Q3 2026 after SOC2 posture improved. If customer requests, offer partner-run on-prem pilot (long shot).
